Excellent service.
I highly recommend them.
Very attentive.

Hello Madam,
Our cat is nearing the end of her life, and we cannot afford to have her euthanized by a veterinarian. Could you please tell me if this is possible through your clinic and what the procedure is?
I have been trying to reach you for about twenty days without success.

Thank you in advance.
Sincerely,

What's the point of this clinic? It's useless. You come with your sick pet, and they don't care. Oh, it must be a cushy job for employees paid to do nothing. I'm not talking about the vets, I'm talking about the receptionists who couldn't care less. They don't even look at you. And as for the animals, they couldn't care less. They have nothing to do, no compassion whatsoever. The only problem is that the animals suffer longer because I get the impression they just don't care. I used to give a lot at the end of the year, but this year, nothing at all, and that's it, I'm giving nothing. And when I say I used to give a lot, I mean it, but now I'm giving nothing. I'll give to other associations or shelters, but it's pointless; they just don't care. It's a disgrace, the only thing that lets us know, like the SPA on the phone, and they never answer, is that we have some turkey who tells us, you've reached the SPA, and of course I know I'm at the SPA, since I called the SPA and nobody answers me.

I highly recommend this center for your pet's care: they were responsive, attentive, and professional, and the receptionist was very kind and took the time to speak with each client. It was my first time having an animal spayed (my little cat), and they were kind and reassuring. Thank you so much!
Very welcoming, affordable assistance for animals

I sincerely believe that the so-called manager's place would be more at the reception desk of the CAF (Family Allowance Fund) or the tax office than within an association that claims to be humane. You can't call yourself such an organization and behave so deplorably towards a completely distraught young woman. You interrupted me, raised your voice, threatened to call the police when there was absolutely no reason to do so, and didn't even take a few seconds to look at my cat or listen to the situation. I completely understand that there's no more room; that's not my complaint. I know you're overworked and overloaded, but that doesn't give you the right to speak to people like that. What I object to is your total lack of humanity and empathy. If I go to a clinic when I already have a veterinarian, it's obviously because I'm in a situation of extreme distress. My cat is nearing the end of his life, and I'm doing everything I can for him. I arrived with a glimmer of hope, but I left even more heartbroken than when I arrived.

I don't usually leave reviews, but this is the first time in my life I've been treated this way. I left quietly so as not to bother anyone, but I wanted to share this experience. To you, Madam Manager, since I know you'll probably read this message: I sincerely hope that one day you'll understand what such distress represents and realize the impact your words and actions can have on people already going through one of the most painful times of their lives. On the other hand, I want to thank the young woman who was with you, who tried to be more pleasant and show a modicum of kindness.

(Oh yes, and by the way, my cat eventually passed away, so thank you very much.)

Hello, I've been trying to call for 15 days to find someone to neuter my two six-month-old kittens. They don't answer at all, and I'd rather have all my cats neutered there. Since then, they haven't answered at all.

No listening, no understanding, no attention to our situation with two elderly people entering a nursing home, one of whom is terminally ill. They tell you they'll review your case and keep you informed. I'm still waiting for the call. Disappointed by the animal shelter; they only have a dachshund to rehome because its owners are very elderly and we don't live in the area and work. The contact was cold and dismissive. Avoid at all costs.

Hello,
Your feedback means a lot to us. Thank you for your trust.

Best wishes,
The clinic team

Hello,
Thank you for your kind review! It was a pleasure to be able to help you.

Sincerely,
The Clinic Team

Caring professionals ✨️
Genuine attention to animals

Hello,
We sincerely thank you for your very positive feedback. Your trust is invaluable.

With our best wishes,
The clinic team

Hello,
Thank you for this excellent review!
Take care,
The clinic team

A warm welcome from the receptionist, who is always kind, helpful, and smiling, and who always tries her best. A very good receptionist. She calls you back to the top-notch veterinarians. Well done to the whole team. I've been a client for 3 or 4 years.

A huge thank you to the entire team for their kindness and professionalism. 🫶🏻
I was very stressed about my pet's surgery 🥹 but I was completely reassured as soon as I arrived.

Everything went very smoothly, and the advice for post-operative care was clear and invaluable.

I highly recommend them.

It would be good if he responded, because my friends and I have called them at least 10 times about different situations and they haven't. The last guy who went there came out with donations that were reported as suspicious, and microchips, and the secretary—it's a scandal.

Hello,
Thank you so much for this lovely review! We're delighted we were able to help.

Best regards,
The clinic team
Excellent service, very kind and competent veterinarian. Very good for those on a budget. THANK YOU SO MUCH for your dedication and kindness towards our pets.

Hello,
Your positive feedback is very heartwarming. Thank you for your trust.

The clinic team
Great clinic 🏥 it helps the most vulnerable without making us feel guilty. …

Hello,
Thank you for this positive feedback.

With our warmest regards,
The clinic team
I had taken my female cat in very bad shape...and they helped me so much here, thank you!

I would like to sincerely thank the entire team at the Marseille SPA clinic for their warm welcome, kindness, and professionalism.
Your dedication to animals is admirable. Thank you from the bottom of my heart. I am so relieved about my Denver.
💖

---

🙏 More formal version

> I wish to express my sincere gratitude to the team at the Marseille SPA clinic for the quality of care provided and for their availability.
Your commitment to animal welfare and your kindness make a real difference.
Thank you for everything you do every day for animals and their owners.

---

> A big thank you to the entire team at the Marseille SPA clinic for your invaluable help and kindness. You do a fantastic job.
Very attentive. Essential for animal lovers on a budget. Thank you for being there for us.

I brought my very sick dog in. The receptionist was not welcoming at all. I won't be going back to Toulon. She told me there's zero animal protection. Yeah, right! In life, you always find solutions, especially when you love animals. I advise against it. Maybe the vet is good, but she should change professions. That's my thought for all the animals I love.

I had my cat neutered at this clinic.

I received excellent service; the staff were attentive and very caring. It was a pleasure to deal with such a warm and welcoming team.
Thank you for your work and everything you do for our animals!

I went to the veterinary clinic for my kitten. The website clearly stated it was open at the time I planned to go. When I arrived, the clinic was closed for summer holidays. Nothing was indicated online, except that it was open.

It's a bit difficult to get them to answer the phone; you have to call about 10 times nonstop before they finally pick up, even if you're persistent like they were with me 🤣. Even so, the staff were very friendly and the vet was very attentive. Everything was very quick and they always kept me informed. I left very happy. €40 for both vaccinations for my cats compared to €140 at a regular vet. Thank goodness they exist! Thank you so much, really 😊

The receptionists were excellent, and the veterinarian was very attentive.
A big thank you for my dog ​​Poppy's surgery.

Honestly, absolutely fantastic! My cat, Bella, regained her playful spirit in just one day. With her heat cycles, she wasn't the same anymore, thanks to the expertise of the SPA (Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals). Despite her distress and despair at seeing her so unwell, they quickly took care of Bella and met her needs. Thank you so much, and thank you for your donations! 🙏 SPA Marseille, thank you for your warm welcome! 💕 I highly, highly recommend them.
A thousand thanks to the clinic and its team for their care, warm welcome, and professionalism. We couldn't be happier or more grateful for the quality of your work with our beloved dogs.

I went to the clinic in March 2025. My dog ​​had stopped eating, and the only option offered was euthanasia. I refused, but they accused me of animal abuse, made me sign a waiver, and denied me access to care. As a result, I'm no longer allowed to go to the clinic, even though I saved my dog's life and, in hindsight, it seems they were the incompetent ones. To believe you don't know your dog after 13 years together and that he would still be alive at this advanced age if you mistreated him—a lack of intelligence or common sense, I don't know—but I recommend the animal foundation. The veterinarians there are kinder, more caring, and, above all, more competent.
Thank you to the team and the secretary in particular, a very convenient and impeccable location.
Very kind and takes the upcoming procedures seriously
Excellent service, very kind receptionist, professional staff offering excellent advice, and very responsive by phone and email. I highly recommend this clinic.
Great experience. Thank you so much for the cats.
Excellent experience, pleasant and very attentive team.
They were unreachable.
I'm still waiting for a reply to my message from 2023; they never respond. Therefore, I don't recommend this clinic unless you want to waste your time.
The staff are truly understanding and put the animal at the heart of their priorities. I was very pleasantly surprised by the welcome our cat received.

An exceptional welcome from highly professional people, excellent advice, and a smile... Easily reachable by email.

Thank you very much.
Do you plan to answer the phone one day, or what?

I have an appointment with them in two hours and I need some information. Regarding my cat, I haven't been able to reach anyone by phone since this morning. I've called them eight times. I don't know what's happening there, but their administrative skills are nonexistent.
